Apache Test Site

vulns.title: ProFTPD mod_copy Unauthenticated Remote File Copy / RCE
vulns.description: mod_copy in ProFTPD 1.3.5 allows remote attackers to read and write arbitrary files on the server via SITE CPFR and SITE CPTO commands without authentication.
vulns.remediation: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.5a or disable mod_copy in proftpd.conf.

vulns.title: OpenSSH PKCS#11 Provider Remote Code Execution
vulns.description: Remote code execution in ssh-agent via PKCS#11 provider libraries when SSH agent forwarding is enabled.
vulns.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.3p2 or newer. Disable SSH Agent forwarding when connecting to untrusted hosts.

vulns.title: OpenSSH regreSSHion - Remote Unauthenticated Code Execution
vulns.description: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
vulns.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.8p1 or newer immediately, or set 'LoginGraceTime 0' as temporary workaround.

vulns.title: OpenSSH Privilege Escalation via Supplementary Groups
vulns.description: OpenSSH failed to properly initialize supplementary groups when executing AuthorizedKeysCommand or AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand.
vulns.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 8.8p1 or higher.

vulns.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal & Remote Code Execution
vulns.description: Flaw in path normalization in Apache 2.4.49 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to map URLs to files outside the document root (Path Traversal) and execute CGI scripts.
vulns.remediation: Immediately upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or higher.

vulns.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal & RCE (Incomplete Fix for CVE-2021-41773)
vulns.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 allows path traversal and remote code execution via double-encoded dot segments (%%32%65).
vulns.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or newer.
